Enum Class RunnerJarOption

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<RunnerJarOption>
io.micronaut.runner.build.RunnerJarOption
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<RunnerJarOption>, Constable
public enum RunnerJarOption extends Enum<RunnerJarOption>
Every packaging option of a runner jar, in one table: its name, the type of its value, its default, how the build plugins expose it and the Runner release that added it.

A build plugin passes options to RunnerJarSpec.Builder.option(String, String) by name, as text, and the packaging library parses, validates and defaults them. A plugin therefore owns no Runner default and no Runner parsing; it only decides which options get a typed property of their own.

Rules

  • Options are added only in Runner minor releases.
  • A new option starts as RunnerJarOption.Exposure.PASSTHROUGH: a build sets it by name, through the plugin's generic options map, and it needs no plugin release.
  • An option becomes RunnerJarOption.Exposure.TYPED only in a Runner minor release, once its default is settled. The Micronaut build plugins then add its typed property in their next minor release.

Value grammar

RunnerJarSpec.Builder.option(String, String) reads a value according to valueType(), and RunnerJarSpec.effectiveOptions() writes each value back in the same grammar:

  • Boolean: true or false, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace. Anything else fails.
  • Compression: as Compression.parse(String) reads it.
  • List: comma-separated. Entries are trimmed and empty entries dropped, so the empty string is the empty list.
  • Map: one Name: value pair per line, as in MANIFEST.MF but without continuation lines. Surrounding whitespace of names and values is ignored and blank lines are skipped, so the empty string is the empty map.
Since:
1.0
